t: The Sylvania Toledo E27 GLS LED Light Bulb offers an energy-efficient lighting solution for various applications. This frosted 4W LED bulb produces 470 lumens of instant light with uniform distribution, making it an ideal choice for general illumination in domestic or commercial properties, including workshops and offices. Its compact design and E27 cap fitting ensure straightforward installation as a direct replacement for older incandescent or halogen bulbs. Boasting a substantial 15,000-hour average rated life and good colour rendering (CRI 80), this non-dimmable LED lamp provides long-lasting, quality light, reducing maintenance needs for tradespeople.
